name: AdxSmas (ADX gated SMA3/6 cross)
author: berlinguyinca collection (author not stated in file)
entry_long: ADX>25 AND SMA3 crosses above SMA6
exit: ADX<25 AND SMA6 crosses above SMA3 (i.e. short SMA cross below long)
implementation_notes: Exit requires ADX<25 AND cross, so may hold long through whipsaws; ROI/stop do the rest. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
